task: Implement replication phase V7 (projectiles, throwables and deployables) from plans/replication/phases/phase-v7-projectiles.md: ten tasks covering an engine-free ballistics core, a server projectile authority, the S_PROJECTILE_SPAWN wire, grenades, the throwable release, guided missiles, deployables, the server-side VFX hold, and retiring InputButtons.ThrowGrenade.
scoutSummary: Ironfront is a C#/netstandard netcode stack (Ironfront.Net.Protocol, .Replication) with a Unity 6000.3 client/server tree under Ironfront_Reborn/Assets. V1-V6 are merged on develop; no V7 work existed. Scout found two plan-vs-reality conflicts the plan did not anticipate: (1) V3 had ALREADY shipped ProjectileSpawnMessage at 19 bytes with an explicit 'there is no projectile id' decision, which V7-D6/D8 re-parameterization requires; (2) ProjectileKind already existed in Ironfront.Net.Protocol, so the plan's Task 1 table would have created a duplicate enum of the kind the codebase already had to consolidate out once (VehicleDespawnReason). Also found: S_PROJECTILE_SPAWN is channel 2 (reliable-ordered), which removes the need for an id quarantine; Quantize.PackVel16 already covers 300 m/s muzzle speeds; ActorManager.Explode is already client-guarded from V1; Weapon already declares a virtual Update that ThrowableWeapon must override rather than hide; Net/Shared and Net/Server are asmdef assemblies that can never reference Assembly-CSharp.
acceptanceCriteria: A bullet's trajectory is identical at 30 Hz and 144 Hz and hit detection no longer varies with frame time (criterion 2)
Damage is computed only on the server from the server's own distance accumulator; a modified client cannot change a damage number (criterion 3, V7-D3)
A throw releases on the same server tick regardless of framerate or animation state, and a client spawns no projectile of its own (criterion 4, V7-D7)
A guided missile re-parameterizes through S_PROJECTILE_SPAWN only, with no new opcode and no per-tick snapshot entry (criterion 5, V7-D6)
An ammo bag resupplies and a medipack heals only through the server; the medipack's shortened lifetime is visible to clients (criterion 6, V7-D8)
A headless server's live-projectile count returns to zero within one tick of the last detonation and the id pool is clean across five matches (criterion 7)
dotnet test green across the solution; no System.Linq, no foreach and no per-tick allocation in new logic files (criterion 12)
grep for ThrowGrenade finds nothing outside the retired enum row's comment (criterion 13)

blastRadius: Offline single-player bullet drop CHANGES: Ballistics.Step and Projectile.Update gained the half-acceleration term, making the arc exact and timestep-invariant. This is a third deliberate change to offline behaviour beyond V7-D11's two recorded ones, taken because the plan's own arc test could not pass against the semi-implicit Euler the plan described, and because offline drop was already a function of framerate and so was never one defined trajectory.
Offline hit registration CHANGES: the swept segment is no longer doubled (V7-D5-local, accepted under brainstorm D8)
Server throw timing CHANGES: a headless server threw instantly and a client ~0.6 s later; both now schedule from Weapon.Configuration.releaseDelay (V7-D7)
Grenade, deployable and javelin behaviour is role-branched; offline paths are unchanged except the two above
Detonated projectiles are destroyed immediately on a server instead of being held 18 s for particles
